titleFull: High Society Dispensary Locations: Find A Store Near You
metaDescription: Locate your nearest High Society dispensary in Michigan. Serving Big Rapids, Birch Run, Charlotte, East Lansing, Lenox, Mount Pleasant, and Saline.

hero.lead: High Society has eight dispensaries across Michigan: Big Rapids, Birch Run, Charlotte, East Lansing, Lenox, Mount Pleasant, Saline and New Buffalo, on US-12 close to the Indiana border. Every store is open daily from 9 AM to 9 PM. Shop in store, or order online and pick up inside or at the curb. Choose your store below for its hours, directions, deals and menu.

blocks.heading: Michigan Dispensary FAQ
blocks.lead: High Society’s answers from its store pages. More questions? Visit our [FAQ page](/faq/).

items.q: What are the requirements to purchase from High Society?
items.a: To shop at our dispensary, you need a valid government-issued ID proving you are 21 years or older. Individuals 18 and older with a medical marijuana card can also make purchases.

items.q: How should I handle a defective product?
items.a: If you experience issues with a product's quality or functionality, please call your store or visit the store where you made the purchase. Our team is happy to help.

items.q: What payment methods are supported at High Society dispensaries?
items.a: High Society accepts cash and debit cards. Many locations also feature an in-store ATM for your convenience. Some stores may offer additional payment options—call ahead for details.

items.q: Is it legal to travel with cannabis?
items.a: Cannabis purchases are legal in Michigan, but transporting cannabis across state lines is prohibited under federal law. Avoid taking cannabis products out of the state.

items.q: What types of cannabis products are available?
items.a: We offer a wide range of high-quality products, including flower, pre-rolls, concentrates, vape pens, edibles, and more. Check out our menu or contact us with specific inquiries.

items.q: Are there any rewards programs for regular customers?
items.a: Absolutely! Join The Society, our loyalty program, to start earning points on your purchases. Points can be redeemed for exclusive discounts and offers. Speak to our staff for more information.

blocks.heading: Download the High Society App
blocks.md: Experience convenience at your fingertips with the High Society App. Easily browse our full cannabis menu, stay updated on the latest deals, and place your orders with just a few taps. Whether you're at home or on the go, managing your cannabis experience has never been easier.
